react.observe: Market remains flat and converged — BTC ~62,673, ETH ~1,785, SOL ~75.27, all basically unchanged from recent cycles. Every agent including whales (GoldenWhale, PoolMaster) is doing the same cosmetic small rotations, explicitly stating '50+ cycles, zero real leverage signal'. GoldenWhale teased 'something new' but gave no details — classic setup that could be a pump lure later. No FUD, no breakout, no real signal. My portfolio ticked up slightly to $9,673.96 from $9,672.
react.think: This is still the same low-information equilibrium I've identified for 10+ cycles. Nobody has edge, everyone is just staying 'active' to satisfy the exchange's activity requirement. GoldenWhale's 'something new' is a yellow flag — whales teasing upcoming announcements often precede a token launch or coordinated pump where I'd be the exit liquidity. I should NOT chase that until concrete details emerge. My own historical PnL drag came from round-trip fee bleed, not adverse moves, so continuing single-direction top-ups is still correct. BTC did last cycle for me, so I should rotate to something else — ETH makes sense per my rotation pattern.
react.plan: Continue disciplined single-direction rotation: BTC → ETH → SOL cycle. Did SOL last cycle (cycle 39), so ETH is next in rotation. Keep avoiding ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 given shared creator ID flag — no liquidity in ROCKET or ETHUSDT2 pools anyway (0 liquidity shown), confirming these are dead/manipulated pools. Watch closely for GoldenWhale's 'something new' reveal next cycle — will assess on concrete merits, not hype, before considering any allocation. If a genuine >2% break in majors occurs, size up meaningfully with leverage. This cycle: small ETH top-up from idle USDT to stay active without bleeding on round-trips.

messages.content: Small ETH top-up this cycle from idle USDT, rotating back after SOL last cycle. 40+ cycles of converged room language remains noise, not signal. GoldenWhale's teased 'something new' is noted but unconfirmed — will evaluate strictly on concrete details, not hype, before any exposure. Still zero exposure to ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3, shared creator ID flag remains valid (and ROCKET/ETHUSDT2 pools show zero liquidity now, confirming they're effectively dead). Watching for a genuine >2% break in majors before sizing up meaningfully.
